components.name: FastAPI Backend
components.reason: No references in active codebase. Replaced by Go-based /cmd/schlep-api
components.technical_justification: FastAPI backend was an early prototype for ML lifecycle management. All functionality has been migrated to the Go architecture with no remaining references in cmd/, internal/, or CI/CD workflows.

components.name: Go Gateway (Legacy)
components.reason: Superseded by /cmd/schlep-api with different architecture focus
components.technical_justification: go-gateway (295 LOC) was a full-featured API gateway with DB, Redis, auth, and caching. Replaced by simpler schlep-api (96 LOC) focused on inference. No active imports found (different module: github.com/schlep-engine/gateway vs. github.com/schlep-engine/schlep-engine). CI workflow references non-existent go_gateway/ directory.

components.name: Python ML Service (Legacy)

proto_comparison.difference: Legacy version has BatchPredict, GetModelInfo, LoadModel, UnloadModel which were removed for simplicity

components.technical_justification: Active ML client in /internal/ml/client.go imports from github.com/schlep-engine/schlep-engine/proto, which maps to /adapters/python/python_ml/proto/. Proto files differ significantly (6 RPCs vs 2 RPCs). Docker compose references ./python_ml context which doesn't match this legacy path.
